blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Cancer may have changed their lives, but it did not take away their hope. Two breast cancer survivors shared how faith, medical treatment and family support helped them navigate years of uncertainty, urging women to seek early detection and patients to remain hopeful. Grace Lao Isidro, a retired pharmacist who has lived with Stage 4 breast cancer for 19 years, and Bebot Oleban, who has been cancer-free for 17 years after a Stage 2B diagnosis, recounted their experiences during the Breast Cancer Awareness Month celebration here.
